text:
Type: armless three-seat sofa bed
Use: seating, sleeping guests; living room, guest room, studio apartment
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: cotton-linen look fabric cover, long skirt, pull-out bed mechanism
Colors: light beige, warm natural sand
Shape: flat wide seat platform, two loose back cushions, low rounded side bolster, pull handle at the front, skirt to the floor, simple and long
Feel: relaxed, soft, casual, practical
Goes with: light wood, white walls, beige and grey textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist guest rooms and studios
